brief:
Shehab Wire reported that the armed group "Deterrence" fought off an infiltration attempt by what it described as collaborationist gangs east of Shujayea. The group said it inflicted casualties on the attackers and reported the death of civilian Akram Hasneen during the clash.

The confrontation occurred in an area where armed factions have clashed with groups accused of working with Israeli forces, a recurring source of tension in Gaza's security landscape.

title: Deterrence group repels infiltration attempt by armed gangs east of Gaza
